source_note: The RM catalogue tables hold 4 tenants' copies of one vocabulary; every row here is DISTINCT on name. Measured totals vs distinct: card_type 293->74, project_type 26->7, project_type_phase 46->14, type x card-type 282->100, capability 68->17, priority_level 16->4, deliverable_kind 8->2, milestone_kind 20->5, board_template 4->1, wip_limit 26->7. pm_gates and architecture_standards are EMPTY, so their two rows are hand-authored. The `standard` board_template is hand-authored: RM ships only `default`, but `projects.create` and `project_requests.promote` default to `standard` (S05's DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_CODE / DEFAULT_BOARD_TEMPLATE), so a tenant seeded without it cannot create a project.
matrix_note: RM's type x card-type matrix is (card_type, phase, is_entry) -- which phase a card type is used in -- NOT board lane transitions. It is imported verbatim under project_type.meta.card_types. S05's may_move reads meta.matrix in a different shape ({card_type: {from_list_kind: [to_list_kind]}}), so every imported project type also carries the standard lane flow for each of its card types; a project type that needs a different flow overrides meta.matrix.
